study type: Prospective, observational, multicenter, registry-based cohort study
exposure: Hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) severity (mild, moderate, severe)
cohort: The study included infants born at >=34 weeks gestational age who displayed evidence of neonatal encephalopathy and were registered in the Turkish Hypoxic Ischemic Encephalopathy Online Registry database between March 2020 and April 2022.
finding: The incidence of HIE among infants born at >=36 weeks GA was 2.13 per 1000 live births, and the timing of therapeutic hypothermia initiation did not significantly impact the occurrence of brain lesions on MRI or mortality.
